::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 10th 1866  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Iowa; MsL/Y56/1866
:::

Dear Sir,
Many thanks for the poem which is to be placed with a collection of autographs made by a member of my family

Yours truly
C M Yonge
